pages.text_en:
Emmy blinked and looked around. It was a bright new morning in the Minecraft Overworld. Bees were buzzing. Cows were grazing. Chickens were pecking.
Her best friend, Birch, was already there, playing in the sunflowers with his pet wolf, Byte.

sentences.text_en: Emmy blinked and looked around.
sentences.zh: Emmy 眨眨眼，环顾四周。

sentences.text_en: It was a bright new morning in the Minecraft Overworld.
sentences.zh: 这是 Minecraft 主世界一个明亮的新早晨。

sentences.text_en: Bees were buzzing.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂嗡嗡地飞着。

sentences.text_en: Cows were grazing.
sentences.zh: 奶牛正在吃草。

sentences.text_en: Chickens were pecking.
sentences.zh: 鸡正在啄食。

sentences.text_en: Her best friend, Birch, was already there, playing in the sunflowers with his pet wolf, Byte.
sentences.zh: 她最好的朋友 Birch 已经在那里了，正和他的宠物狼 Byte 一起在向日葵中玩耍。

pages.text_en:
But Emmy knew that when the sun went down, monsters would return. "Let's get serious," she said. "We don't have any time to waste." "What's your plan?" asked Birch. Emmy always had a plan.
Today we will climb to the very top of Mount Farview," said Emmy, and see what we can see!" Birch gasped. Mount Farview was the tallest mountain around.

sentences.text_en: But Emmy knew that when the sun went down, monsters would return.
sentences.zh: 但 Emmy 知道，太阳落山后，怪物就会回来。

sentences.text_en: "Let's get serious," she said.
sentences.zh: “我们认真起来吧，”她说。

sentences.text_en: "We don't have any time to waste." "What's your plan?" asked Birch.
sentences.zh: “我们没有时间浪费了。”“你的计划是什么？”Birch 问。

sentences.text_en: Emmy always had a plan.
sentences.zh: Emmy 总是有计划。

sentences.text_en: Today we will climb to the very top of Mount Farview," said Emmy, and see what we can see!" Birch gasped.
sentences.zh: “今天我们要爬到远景山的最高处，”Emmy 说，“看看我们能看到什么！”Birch 惊讶地倒吸一口气。

sentences.text_en: Mount Farview was the tallest mountain around.
sentences.zh: 远景山是附近最高的山。

pages.text_en:
Emmy and Birch both knew they would need supplies to travel so far. Byte barked loudly. He pointed his nose at an oak tree.
"Good idea, Byte," said Emmy. "We should get wood right away." I'll do it!" said Birch. He punched the tree. The tree broke apart into blocks of wood.

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch both knew they would need supplies to travel so far.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 都知道，走这么远需要准备补给。

sentences.text_en: Byte barked loudly.
sentences.zh: Byte 大声吠叫。

sentences.text_en: He pointed his nose at an oak tree.
sentences.zh: 它把鼻子指向一棵橡树。

sentences.text_en: "Good idea, Byte," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “好主意，Byte，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "We should get wood right away." I'll do it!" said Birch.
sentences.zh: “我们马上去取木头。”“我来做！”Birch 说。

sentences.text_en: He punched the tree.
sentences.zh: 他用拳头打树。

sentences.text_en: The tree broke apart into blocks of wood.
sentences.zh: 树裂开，变成了一块块木头。

pages.text_en:
When they had enough logs, Emmy made oak planks. She used the planks to create a crafting table.
"Now we can make tools," Emmy said. "We'll craft a shovel, a pickaxe, and a sword—maybe an axe." "Make an extra pickaxe for me!" said Birch.

sentences.text_en: When they had enough logs, Emmy made oak planks.
sentences.zh: 木头收集够后，Emmy 制作了橡木木板。

sentences.text_en: She used the planks to create a crafting table.
sentences.zh: 她用木板制作了一张工作台。

sentences.text_en: "Now we can make tools," Emmy said.
sentences.zh: “现在我们可以制作工具了，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "We'll craft a shovel, a pickaxe, and a sword—maybe an axe." "Make an extra pickaxe for me!" said Birch.
sentences.zh: “我们要做铲子、镐子和剑——也许还要一把斧子。”“给我再做一把镐子！”Birch 说。

pages.text_en:
Now that they had wooden tools, Emmy, Birch, and Byte started walking toward the mountain.
They saw a spider lurking beneath a tree. Birch was ready for it, but the spider would not attack in daylight. It only watched them with its beady red eyes.

sentences.text_en: Now that they had wooden tools, Emmy, Birch, and Byte started walking toward the mountain.
sentences.zh: 有了木制工具后，Emmy、Birch 和 Byte 开始朝山走去。

sentences.text_en: They saw a spider lurking beneath a tree.
sentences.zh: 他们看见一只蜘蛛潜伏在树下。

sentences.text_en: Birch was ready for it, but the spider would not attack in daylight.
sentences.zh: Birch 已经做好准备，但蜘蛛在白天不会攻击。

sentences.text_en: It only watched them with its beady red eyes.
sentences.zh: 它只是用那双小小的红眼睛盯着他们。

pages.text_en:
Finally, they came to the end of the plain. They now stood at the foot of Mount Farview. The mountain was tall. Birch could not see the top. Byte howled—AWOOOO!
"We should gather more supplies," said Emmy. She used her axe to knock apples out of an oak tree. Birch used his pickaxe to gather cobblestone.

sentences.text_en: Finally, they came to the end of the plain.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们走到了平原的尽头。

sentences.text_en: They now stood at the foot of Mount Farview.
sentences.zh: 他们现在站在远景山脚下。

sentences.text_en: The mountain was tall.
sentences.zh: 这座山真高。

sentences.text_en: Birch could not see the top.
sentences.zh: Birch 看不见山顶。

sentences.text_en: Byte howled—AWOOOO!
sentences.zh: Byte 嗷呜长嚎——嗷呜呜呜！

sentences.text_en: "We should gather more supplies," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “我们应该再收集一些补给，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: She used her axe to knock apples out of an oak tree.
sentences.zh: 她用斧子从橡树上砍下苹果。

sentences.text_en: Birch used his pickaxe to gather cobblestone.
sentences.zh: Birch 用镐子收集圆石。

pages.text_en:
Without warning, Birch's pickaxe broke! The wooden tool shattered against the hard stone mountain.
"Don't be sad, Birch," said Emmy. "I can use my crafting table to make a new pickaxe for you."

sentences.text_en: Without warning, Birch's pickaxe broke!
sentences.zh: 毫无预兆地，Birch 的镐子坏了！

sentences.text_en: The wooden tool shattered against the hard stone mountain.
sentences.zh: 木制工具撞在坚硬的山石上，碎裂开来。

sentences.text_en: "Don't be sad, Birch," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “别难过，Birch，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "I can use my crafting table to make a new pickaxe for you."
sentences.zh: “我可以用工作台给你做一把新的镐子。”

pages.text_en:
Now Birch had a pickaxe made of stone. It was stronger than his wooden one. Thanks, Emmy!" said Birch, and he smiled.
Together, the friends climbed the mountain until " the sun was low in the sky. "Soon it will be night," said Emmy. "We should stop and build a shelter "' before the monsters come.

sentences.text_en: Now Birch had a pickaxe made of stone.
sentences.zh: 现在 Birch 有了一把石镐。

sentences.text_en: It was stronger than his wooden one.
sentences.zh: 它比原来的木镐更结实。

sentences.text_en: Thanks, Emmy!" said Birch, and he smiled.
sentences.zh: “谢谢你，Emmy！”Birch 说着笑了起来。

sentences.text_en: Together, the friends climbed the mountain until " the sun was low in the sky.
sentences.zh: 朋友们一起爬山，直到太阳低低地挂在天空中。

sentences.text_en: "Soon it will be night," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “天快黑了，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "We should stop and build a shelter "' before the monsters come.
sentences.zh: “我们应该停下来，在怪物出现前搭一个庇护所。”

pages.text_en:
They worked as a team. While Birch mined more cobblestones, Emmy began stacking blocks to make the walls of a house. Byte was no help. He just chased a chicken.
Suddenly, an arrow whizzed through the air. It landed by Emmy's foot—THUNK! It was too late to finish the house!

sentences.text_en: They worked as a team.
sentences.zh: 他们像一个团队一样合作。

sentences.text_en: While Birch mined more cobblestones, Emmy began stacking blocks to make the walls of a house.
sentences.zh: Birch 挖更多圆石时，Emmy 开始堆放方块，建造房子的墙。

sentences.text_en: Byte was no help.
sentences.zh: Byte 一点忙也没帮上。

sentences.text_en: He just chased a chicken.
sentences.zh: 它只顾着追一只鸡。

sentences.text_en: Suddenly, an arrow whizzed through the air.
sentences.zh: 突然，一支箭嗖地穿过空气。

sentences.text_en: It landed by Emmy's foot—THUNK!
sentences.zh: 箭落在 Emmy 脚边——砰！

sentences.text_en: It was too late to finish the house!
sentences.zh: 现在再想把房子建完已经太晚了！

pages.text_en:
It's a skeleton!" cried Birch. He raised his pickaxe. He was not going to let a hostile mob shoot arrows at his friend!
Birch charged at the skeleton, and Byte dashed after him! Emmy pulled out her sword.

sentences.text_en: It's a skeleton!" cried Birch.
sentences.zh: “是骷髅！”Birch 喊道。

sentences.text_en: He raised his pickaxe.
sentences.zh: 他举起了镐子。

sentences.text_en: He was not going to let a hostile mob shoot arrows at his friend!
sentences.zh: 他绝不会让敌对生物向朋友射箭！

sentences.text_en: Birch charged at the skeleton, and Byte dashed after him!
sentences.zh: Birch 向骷髅冲去，Byte 也紧跟着冲了上去！

sentences.text_en: Emmy pulled out her sword.
sentences.zh: Emmy 拔出了剑。

pages.text_en:
The skeleton reached for another arrow, but Byte bit him on the leg! The skeleton wobbled as it tried to aim.
Birch hit it with a swing of his pickaxe! And Emmy delivered the final blow to the mob.

sentences.text_en: The skeleton reached for another arrow, but Byte bit him on the leg!
sentences.zh: 骷髅伸手去拿另一支箭，但 Byte 咬住了它的腿！

sentences.text_en: The skeleton wobbled as it tried to aim.
sentences.zh: 骷髅试着瞄准时，身体摇摇晃晃。

sentences.text_en: Birch hit it with a swing of his pickaxe!
sentences.zh: Birch 挥起镐子，狠狠击中了它！

sentences.text_en: And Emmy delivered the final blow to the mob.
sentences.zh: Emmy 给这个生物送上了最后一击。

pages.text_en:
"Good job!" said Emmy. "But now there will be more monsters. And we have nowhere to hide."
" "We can take them, Birch said. "Fighting monsters is scary— and fun!"

sentences.text_en: "Good job!" said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “干得好！”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: "But now there will be more monsters.
sentences.zh: “可是现在会有更多怪物了。

sentences.text_en: And we have nowhere to hide." " "We can take them, Birch said.
sentences.zh: 我们没有地方躲藏。”“我们能对付它们，”Birch 说。

sentences.text_en: "Fighting monsters is scary— and fun!"
sentences.zh: “和怪物战斗既吓人——又有趣！”

pages.text_en:
The night was long, and the path up the mountain was dangerous.
Emmy, Birch, and Byte fought all the zombies, skeletons, and creepers that spawned in their path.

sentences.text_en: The night was long, and the path up the mountain was dangerous.
sentences.zh: 夜晚很漫长，登山的道路也很危险。

sentences.text_en: Emmy, Birch, and Byte fought all the zombies, skeletons, and creepers that spawned in their path.
sentences.zh: Emmy、Birch 和 Byte 击退了路上生成的所有僵尸、骷髅和苦力怕。

pages.text_en: When the sun rose, the final zombie burst into flames! Now they could finish their journey. "We made it," said Emmy. They stepped onto the snowy peak of the mountain.

sentences.text_en: When the sun rose, the final zombie burst into flames!
sentences.zh: 太阳升起时，最后一只僵尸着火了！

sentences.text_en: Now they could finish their journey.
sentences.zh: 现在他们可以完成旅程了。

sentences.text_en: "We made it," said Emmy.
sentences.zh: “我们做到了，”Emmy 说。

sentences.text_en: They stepped onto the snowy peak of the mountain.
sentences.zh: 他们踏上了山的积雪覆盖的山顶。

pages.text_en: Emmy and Birch could see a desert, a swamp, a forest, and an ocean. The Overworld was a big place, and their adventures were just beginning.

sentences.text_en: Emmy and Birch could see a desert, a swamp, a forest, and an ocean.
sentences.zh: Emmy 和 Birch 看见了沙漠、沼泽、森林和海洋。

sentences.text_en: The Overworld was a big place, and their adventures were just beginning.
sentences.zh: 主世界很大，而他们的冒险才刚刚开始。
